title: Typed Continuation Composition Guards
purpose: Strengthen continuation composition by requiring endpoint compatibility, admissibility, residue propagation, and typed-domain compatibility.
core_claim: Continuation composition is lawful only when endpoint matching, admissibility, residue propagation, and typed-domain compatibility all hold.

canonical_claims.statement: Continuation composition is lawful only when endpoint matching and type compatibility both hold.
Typed-domain mismatch blocks composition unless an explicit typed transition rule exists.
Projection-domain transitions require Π_D or an equivalent canonical projection rule.
Composition failure produces no continuation object.
Reduction of composed continuations is permitted only after typed composition guards pass.

formal_objects.name: Typed Continuation Composition Guards
formal_objects.definition: Lawful continuation composition guards requiring endpoint matching, admissibility, residue propagation, and typed-domain compatibility.

typed_composition_rules.name: Endpoint Match Guard
typed_composition_rules.formal: C(A,B) ∘ C(B,C) is structurally composable only if cod(C(A,B)) = dom(C(B,C))

typed_composition_rules.name: Residue Propagation Guard
typed_composition_rules.formal: Compose(C1,C2) must preserve lawful residue propagation

typed_composition_rules.name: Guarded Reduction Dependency
typed_composition_rules.formal: C(A,B) ∘ C(B,C) ->red C(A,C) only after TCG_021_001 through TCG_021_004 pass

validation_requirements: Projection transition exceptions require typed transition rules.
Reduction rules are guarded by typed composition validity.

next_recommended_patch.title: Continuation Failure Object and Undefined Composition
next_recommended_patch.purpose: Define the failure object or undefined-state semantics for inadmissible continuation composition.
